Method of Attack: Abuse of Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL) to hide malicious code from security products
Loaders for WSL environment injecting malware into running processes using Windows API calls
Use of Python 3 and PowerShell to execute shellcode, kill antivirus, establish persistence, and run scripts
Impacted Systems: Windows machines with Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL)
Attack Vector: Injection of malware into running Windows processes via Windows API calls
Use of Python 3 ELF executables packaged with PyInstaller
Indicators of Compromise: Public IP address 185.63.90[.]137 (offline at time of research)
File hashes and data available on Lumen’s Black Lotus Labs GitHub page
